subject: Three-mode product direction
decision: LibreCare direction is based on three perspectives: caregiver, senior, and clinician.
reason: The same glucose data must support different primary questions and cognitive needs for each perspective.
counterargument: A single generic mode could reduce configuration complexity, but it weakens role-specific clarity and usability.
revisit_condition: Revisit only if validated usage data indicates the three-mode model no longer reflects real user needs.
